About me

Results-driven Staff/Lead Data Scientist and AI Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and delivering end-to-end data science, machine learning, geospatial analytics, and AI solutions that solve complex business challenges and create measurable business value. Experienced in developing predictive models, recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, marketing analytics, causal inference, customer analytics, and connected vehicle intelligence using Python, SQL, Spark, Databricks, Azure, and cloud-based AI platforms. Proven ability to transform large-scale structured and unstructured data into actionable insights that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and strategic decision-making.

Strong background in building production-ready machine learning pipelines, Generative AI applications, LLM-powered assistants, and geospatial analytics solutions while collaborating with engineering, product, marketing, and business stakeholders. Passionate about leveraging AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and data engineering to develop scalable, high-impact products across automotive, retail, transportation, and technology industries, with a focus on delivering innovative, data-driven solutions from concept through deployment.
